sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant has falsely been implicated in the present case due to previous enmity.
She has further stated the appellant and the Informant have solemnized their marriage on 17.05.2023 and, therefore, Section 376 IPC is not made out against the appellant.
There is a delay of twenty-five days in lodging the F.I.R. without assigning any reason for the same.
He further submits that later on, sweet relation has been developed between the parties and have also jointly filed compromise petition on 07.12.2023 before the court below.
In the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she has not whispered a single word against the appellant.
Charge-sheet has been submitted in this case.
Charges have also been framed.
Learned counsel for the Patna High Court CR. APP (SJ) No.318 of 2024(3) dt.14-03-2024 appellant further submits that the appellant has not taken the caste name of the informant in public view.
Hence, no offence under the provisions of SC/ST Act is made out against him.
The appellant has no intention to disgrace the image of the informant in public view.
The appellant is in custody since 03.11.2023 and has no criminal antecedent.
6. Learned Special P.P. for the State and the informant have vehemently opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the appellant.
7. The Informant has herself appeared before this Court in person and has submitted that she has not objection if the appellant is granted bail.
She has also stated that she has married to another person namely Rishi Kumar.
8. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and the period of custody undergone by the appellant, this Court is inclined to allow this appeal.
Accordingly, the appeal is allowed and order dated 20.12.2023 passed by learned 1st Additional Sessions Judge cum Special Judge (SC/ST), Aurangabad is hereby set aside.
